if doc.email and doc.customer_name:
    # check if customer already exists
    existing_customer = frappe.db.exists("Customer", {"email_id": doc.email})

    if not existing_customer:
        customer = frappe.new_doc("Customer")
        customer.customer_name = doc.customer_name
        customer.email_id = doc.email
        customer.mobile_no = doc.phone
        customer.customer_group = "Individual"
        customer.territory = "All Territories"
        customer.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

        # optional: link back to request if field exists
        if "customer" in doc.as_dict():
            doc.db_set("customer", customer.name)

        frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Customer {customer.customer_name} created successfully.")
    else:
        frappe.msgprint("⚠️ Customer already exists, linking skipped.")
else:
    frappe.log_error("Missing customer_name or email", "Car Repair Request Auto-Creation")

# Capture timestamps when approval happens
if doc.workflow_state == "Approved":

    # Identify who approved (optional logic)
    if frappe.session.user != "Administrator":
        user_roles = frappe.get_roles(frappe.session.user)
        
        # If user is Customer
        if "Customer" in user_roles and not doc.customer_approved_on:
            doc.customer_approved_on = now_datetime()

        # If user is Service Provider
        elif "Service Provider" in user_roles and not doc.service_provider_approved_on:
            doc.service_provider_approved_on = now_datetime()
